sloka: विमृशंश्च न पश्यामि यो हते मयि वानरः ।शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं लङ्गयेत महोदधिम् ।। ५.३०.३३।।।।
transliteration: vimṛśaṁśca na paśyāmi yo hate mayi vānaraḥ ।śatayojanavistīrṇaṁ laṅgayeta mahodadhim ।। 5.30.33।।।।

translations.english: "When I am killed here, I cannot see any other vanara who can leap over a hundred yojanas of the ocean (to reach this place).
